about: Team decisions about how we observe our trading agents. A verdict informs; the team decides.

instructions.question: Given `constraints`, which observability backend should we ship first to see every negotiation (messages, offers, Jev verdicts, guardrail denials, errors) and to run evals later?
instructions.note: Speed to a working, shared UI tonight matters most. All options would receive OpenTelemetry (OTLP) spans from our Python runtime.

criteria.phoenix: Arize Phoenix: one open-source container, OTLP-native, agent/LLM trace UI and an evals framework, self-hostable or free cloud.
criteria.langfuse: Langfuse: open-source LLM observability with traces, prompts and evals; self-hosting v3 needs Postgres, ClickHouse, Redis and blob storage, or use its cloud.
criteria.jaeger: Jaeger: one OTLP-native container with a generic distributed-tracing UI, no LLM or eval features.
criteria.jsonl_dashboard: No tracing backend: write JSONL events and build our own dashboard on top.
